```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(plotit); library(pullit); library(factorem)
# The synthetic database that ships with pullit stands in for Bloomberg.
path <- system.file("extdata", "storethat.sqlite", package = "pullit")
start <- "2024-11-01"; end <- "2026-11-13"
```

[plotit](https://dev.bautheac.net/plotit/) provides plot methods for objects
from [pullit](https://dev.bautheac.net/pullit/) and
[factorem](https://dev.bautheac.net/factorem/). The plots below are drawn from a
synthetic Bloomberg database, never real market data.

## pullit

### Futures term structure

Plot the dynamics of a futures series term structure over time. Press play, or
drag the slider, to step through the dates:

```{r futures}
ticker <- "C A Comdty"

term_structure <- pull_futures_market(
  source = "storethat", type = "term structure", active_contract_tickers = ticker,
  start, end, TS_positions = 1L:10L, roll_type = "A", roll_days = 0L,
  roll_months = 0L, roll_adjustment = "N", verbose = FALSE, file = path
  )

plot(term_structure, ticker = ticker)
```

### Fund market

Plot historical fund performance:

```{r fund}
ticker <- "SPY US Equity"

fund <- pull_fund_market(source = "storethat", ticker, start, end, verbose = FALSE, file = path)

plot(fund, ticker = ticker)
```

## factorem

Build a momentum factor on commodity futures:

```{r factor}
tickers <- c(
  "C A Comdty", "S A Comdty", "SMA Comdty", "O A Comdty",
  "W A Comdty", "SBA Comdty", "SIA Comdty", "NGA Comdty"
  )

data <- pull_futures_market(
  source = "storethat", type = "term structure", active_contract_tickers = tickers,
  start, end, TS_positions = 1L, roll_type = "A", roll_days = 0L,
  roll_months = 0L, roll_adjustment = "N", verbose = FALSE, file = path
  )

factor <- momentum_factor(data)
```

### Performance overview

```{r performance}
plot(factor, type = "performance")
```

### Positions overview

```{r positions}
plot(factor, type = "positions")
```
